checks.skill_update: develop-typora-code: main remote workspace verification and build/asset identity; quick_validate PASS

limits: Windows Typora 1.14.10 connected to one real Linux/Python3 host. Other remote platforms and physical mouse/keyboard input are not validated by renderer-driven fixtures.
Directory/Git polling is bounded; opened native Markdown does not yet auto-load external remote changes. Explicit reload and conflict checks remain.

Full remote session recovery, native import/export and image upload, cross-window transfer, advanced Git worktree paths, remote extension host/debug/port forwarding remain outside completed verification.
Sparse host cache rejects Windows-incompatible and case-colliding remote names. File reads/writes capped at 16 MiB and listing at 10000 entries with explicit errors.
Terminal OpenSSH authentication is independent of optional saved file-connection credentials; keys/agent can avoid repeated prompts.
Earlier failed builds left old assets for some image attempts. These are not evidence for the changed source. Final private-host bundle hashes were checked before PASS runs.
Installed assets do not imply running windows loaded the candidate; no user windows were restarted.
